journey: docker/container-build workload on a microVM box

narrative.step: acquires the pinned microVM box a `docker build` step would run in → HELD

artifact.gap: whether the box exposes a working Docker daemon (rootless buildkit / dind) is the OWNER-GATED GA image matrix, an image-layer concern not a /v1 verb; a job shelling `docker` on an image without it fails LOUD (command not found, red check) — never a silent pass. The microVM boundary makes even a privileged inner daemon safe by construction
